beats.action: Minho and Jisoo sit on opposite ends of the couch, staring at their phones.

dialogue.speaker: Jisoo
dialogue.text: I really don't care, just pick anything for dinner.

beats.action: Minho sighs, looking at a sports game on the TV in the background.

dialogue.speaker: Minho
dialogue.text: I’m tired. My brain is as dead as a Terry Bradshaw pass.

dialogue.speaker: Jisoo
dialogue.text: Don't bring NFL legends into our takeout drama, Minho.

beats.action: Minho gestures at the TV screen where a sports highlight plays.

dialogue.speaker: Minho
dialogue.text: Look, I’d rather analyze the NZ vs IND cricket score.

dialogue.speaker: Jisoo
dialogue.text: Choose now or I’m ordering us a plate of nothing.

beats.action: Minho suddenly sits up, looking like he is making a game-winning play.

dialogue.speaker: Minho
dialogue.text: Fine! I'm channeling Gronk energy. We’re getting pizza, period.

dialogue.speaker: Jisoo
dialogue.text: You actually picked? That was a Tom Brady level decision.

beats.action: Jisoo leans into Minho, both laughing as they pull out the phone.

dialogue.speaker: Minho
dialogue.text: See? Even Erin Andrews would be proud of this teamwork.

dialogue.speaker: Jisoo
dialogue.text: Whatever, just add extra pepperoni, you genius.

music_prompt: Upbeat, light-hearted acoustic guitar with a lo-fi hip-hop beat.
caption: POV: You’ve been staring at a food delivery app for 45 minutes straight.

history_entry.hook: The classic 'I don't care what we eat' stalemate.
history_entry.core_joke: Comparing a simple dinner choice to the intensity of high-stakes sports commentary.
